description: Building, HVAC and battery models and case-study data for risk-averse mFRR flexibility assessment is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Anita Banjac, Nikola Hure (Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing in Zagreb). Identified models, parameters and input profiles of a single-storey retirement and care facility in eastern Austria, used in the paper "Technical versus Economic Viability of Risk-Averse Building Flexibility for Balancing Reserves". Coverage: national (AT); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
